claims: Rory McIlroy won the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Rory McIlroy earned a first-place prize of $4.5 million in the 2026 Masters Tournament.
$4.5 million was a record first-place prize for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The 2026 Masters Tournament had a total purse of $22.5 million.
$22.5 million was a record total purse for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament receives 750 FedExCup points.
The winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament receives a lifetime invitation to the Masters.
The second-place payout for the 2026 Masters Tournament was $2.43 million.
The third-place payout for the 2026 Masters Tournament was $1.08 million
